crossRefs.note: Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes…
Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and…
For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like…
You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the…
The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor…
that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
